item.description:
Disco Darling - Single
“Disco Darling” is an unreleased track by Diamond-certified, GRAMMY® Award-nominated pop singer-songwriter Carly Rae Jepsen, originally recorded for her 2019 album Dedicated before being left on the cutting-room floor. After a demo of the song leaked online, fans have begged for an official release. Now, the fan-favorite track finally gets its moment, arriving exclusively for Record Store Day on baby blue 7” vinyl with a disco ball etching on Side B.
